yathānusandhi.p: (Thī) [yathā+anusandhi] yathānusandhe.(A) Sutta (or) Words which is related with cause and effect/result . (B) According to sutta/words  which is related with cause and result. (C) It is appropriate reference to the context (Anusandhe): Yathānusandhi(pu, thī) [yathā+ anusandhi] yathānusandhe.The cessation of Anusandhe. (1) According to life span. (2) Life span. (3) According to happen continuously. (4) It is joined no gap (or) It is being/happening continuously (Non-stop).(Anusandhe means the relation with cause and result/effect).
